title: Claude Code v2.1.114 - April 2025 Releases
description: Multiple releases in April 2025 including v2.1.114 (April 18), v2.1.113 (April 17), v2.1.112 (April 16), and v2.1.111 (April 16). Key updates: Claude Opus 4.7 xhigh now available, auto mode for Max subscribers, new /ultrareview for comprehensive code review, PowerShell tool rolling out, improved /effort with xhigh level, and numerous bug fixes and improvements.

community_feedback.quote: Looking at the release notes, v2.1.113 had 102 reactions on GitHub showing strong community engagement

title: Claude Opus 4.7 Launch
description: Claude Opus 4.7 is now generally available with improvements in software engineering, complex long-running coding tasks, and better vision with higher resolution. Includes xhigh effort level and auto mode for Max subscribers.

community_feedback.quote: After months with Claude Code, users report the biggest time sink isn't bugs but agent behavior issues
Concerns about $15-$25 per PR cost for Code Review feature and whether pricing model is sustainable
Users report sometimes receiving code they do not understand at all, with concerns about growing technical debt and bloating of codebase

title: Background Agents in Slack
description: You can now launch Background Agents directly from Slack by mentioning @Cursor. Agents can read the thread, understand context, and create PRs in GitHub without leaving the conversation.

title: v0.82.0 - GPT 4.1 Support and New Edit Formats
description: Aider v0.82.0 adds support for GPT 4.1, mini, and nano models, improved architect mode with Gemini 2.5 Pro, support for xAI Grok-3 models and OpenRouter Optimus Alpha, new patch edit format for GPT-4.1, and additional edit formats (editor-diff, editor-whole, editor-diff-fenced). Aider wrote 92% of the code in this release.

community_feedback.quote: Release received strong positive engagement with 26 thumbs up, 7 laugh, 12 hooray, 9 heart, 9 rocket reactions from 41 people on GitHub
Users excited about GPT 4.1 support: 'lin72h', 'renanfranca', 'michabbb', and others showing strong support

title: v0.38.0 - Chapters Narrative Flow
description: Gemini CLI v0.38.0 introduces Chapters Narrative Flow for better session structure, Context Compression Service for efficient history management, UI flicker fixes with Terminal Buffer mode, and persistent policy approvals for tool execution.

title: v1.0.6 - The 'Notch', LLM Logs, and Improved Tools
description: Continue v1.0.6 introduces the 'notch' - an easy-access control panel for custom assistant settings, purpose-built UI for viewing LLM prompts and completions with metadata, faster edit tool, ripgrep for search, glob-based file search for better agent mode navigation and codebase modification.

title: BugBot, Background Agent GA, and One-Click MCP
description: Cursor 1.0 release featuring BugBot for automatic code review, Background Agent now available to all users, MCP one-click install with OAuth support, Memories feature (beta), and richer chat responses with visualizations.

title: v0.37.0 - Dynamic Sandbox Expansion
description: Gemini CLI v0.37.0 features dynamic sandbox expansion and worktree support for Linux and Windows, improved browser capabilities with persistent sessions, and Chapters Narrative Flow for better session organization.

title: Simplified Pricing and Max Mode
description: Unified request-based pricing model, Max Mode available for all top models with token-based pricing, new Tab model for multi-file suggestions, and Background Agent preview for parallel task execution.
